records.reason: Reaction that forces the ATTACKER to reroll and take the lower result; nothing on the player's sheet changes (the 'once per 10 minutes' frequency is not expressible by limitedUses' per values).
Enlarges the Overwatch archetype's 30-foot overwatch field to 60 feet; the overwatch-field subsystem is a table-tracked archetype construct the app does not model, and no sheet statistic changes.
Spellshape action that enlarges the area of the next spell cast; area geometry is resolved at the table and no sheet statistic changes.
Ignores part or all of a target's or object's Hardness on repeated axe Strikes in a turn; target-side damage resolution only.
Alters the shape and duration of the Light spell's effect when cast; a narrative reshaping of a spell resolved at the table, no player statistic changes.
Kineticist impulse action that creates an illusion and imposes fascinated on other creatures via their save vs your class DC; entirely target-side.
Spellshape action that ignores the target's concealment and cover for the next spell attack; a per-cast targeting adjustment resolved at the table.
Imposes a -2 circumstance penalty on ENEMIES' Acrobatics to Tumble Through, and grants a free-action Shove on a melee crit; both are target-side / table-resolved actions.
Grants a two-action activity (Leap then Trip) resolved at the table; no persistent sheet statistic changes.
Grants a one-action double-Shove activity against flanking enemies; table-resolved action affecting targets only.
Grants a one-action activity (Step 5 feet twice); movement resolved at the table, no sheet statistic changes.
Gives the dragon companion an extra ACTION (Winged Leap) that it performs at the table; it changes no companion statistic that COMPANION_MODS expresses (no sense, speed, skill, IWR, or strike rider).

Permanently increases any fly Speed granted by ancestry feats/permanent wings by 5 feet, which is a persistent sheet speed. No lane exists: 'speeds' only sets an absolute value and landSpeedBonus covers land Speed only, so there is no way to add +5 to an existing fly Speed. (The Leap +10 feet half correctly needs nothing, matching Powerful Leap/Winglets which carry no field.)
Only changes Leap/Long Jump distances and removes the no-Stride auto-failure; jump distance is table-resolved and the existing Powerful Leap record sets the precedent of carrying no field.
Lets you Fly normally with the fly Speed of your Werecreature animal shape (removes the sustained-flight restriction); no sheet statistic changes, the animal shape's speed is unaltered.
Ignores concealment caused by ice and snow; a GM-adjudicated environmental exception, not a sense (the senses field has no entry for it) and not a numeric bonus.
Kineticist impulse action dealing damage in an area and creating difficult terrain; entirely target/terrain-side and resolved at the table.

Raises the number of Witch's Charge designations from one to your Int modifier; the charge is recorded as a free-text daily choice on Witch's Charge (choice.flag witchsCharge) and the count is a table-tracked note, with no legal field for a variable number of text picks.
Creates an animated hut with its own statistics that borrows your AC/saves/Perception; it is a separate GM-run structure with commands, not a change to your own sheet.
Kineticist impulse action; all effects (damage, clumsy, immobilized) land on the target via a save vs your class DC.

Broadens the APPLICATION of the void resistance already granted by Necromantic Resistance (resistances void floor(level/2)) to undead attacks of any damage type; it grants no new resistance value, and which incoming attack the resistance applies to is decided during damage resolution.
Teaches the Atone ritual and shifts its outcome one degree on yakshas; rituals are downtime activities the app does not model and the degree shift is GM-resolved.
Widens the range of creatures you may Impersonate; a GM-adjudicated exploration/social permission with no numeric effect.
Shifts Survival degrees of success one step in forests/jungles; no numeric bonus (situational only carries bonuses) and the outcome shift is GM-resolved at the table.
Two-action activity that triggers your own Catharsis reaction early; it grants no new statistic, just an alternate way to spend an existing archetype reaction.
Lets you roll Society for initiative when no enemy is an elf; initiative-skill substitution is chosen at the table and is gated on the GM's enemy roster.
Explicitly grants a named feat/action ('You gain the Shake It Off reaction') and the record carries only a descRef, so the player never receives Shake It Off on the sheet.
Permits Diplomacy to Make an Impression on and Request from cave worms; a GM-adjudicated social permission with no numeric effect.

The leshy familiar REPLACES the familiar the witch class already grants (no new companion), and the foliage clause only waives circumstance penalties/flat checks from vegetation, which is GM-adjudicated cover and not a legal field.
Reaction that lets you Rage when damaged; it grants an action resolved at the table and adds no statistic.
Reaction that lets you Rage when damaged; it grants an action resolved at the table and adds no statistic.
One-action activity creating a smoke cloud that conceals everyone in it; an area/battlefield effect resolved at the table.
A Strike activity; the extra damage dice and the lost spell slot are applied during that Strike's resolution against the target, not as a sheet statistic.
Two-action area damage activity spending a Living History use; all effects land on foes via a save against your DC.
Mythic Point activity granting reach and mythic-proficiency Strikes for one turn during the activity itself; resolved entirely inside the action, not a persistent or toggleable sheet state.
One-action Strike whose reach is 30 feet for that Strike only; per-action reach is resolved at the table.

The gizmo 'can safely synthesize two sea mines a day', a daily resource the player must track, but the record carries no uses field (compare Take Wing, which stores its once-per-round frequency in limitedUses).
A Strike activity that denies the TARGET hidden/concealed and may counteract an effect on it; entirely target-side.
Reaction that makes one triggering attack target your Crafting DC instead of AC; a per-attack substitution resolved at the table, not a change to any sheet value.
A Strike activity that imposes and increases the doomed condition on the target; entirely target-side.
Reaction granting a Stride after casting a self-affecting divine spell; movement resolved at the table, no statistic changes.

Raises the momentary fly Speed used during Take Wing's single Fly action from 15 to 25 feet; Take Wing itself stores no speeds field (correctly, as the flight lasts only that movement), so there is no persistent sheet speed to raise.
Substitutes Performance for Diplomacy/Nature when Requesting from or Commanding animals; a skill substitution for GM-adjudicated social actions, with no bonus or proficiency change.
Free action letting you Sustain a summon animal spell or Command an Animal after a composition; grants an action resolved at the table.
